newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EU expansion "illusion" before 2002 - EU official.
newsitem.headline: EU expansion "illusion" before 2002 - EU official.

text.p: The European Union's representative in Hungary said on Friday any notion that central European states could join the EU before 2002 was "an illusion".

"It would be an illusion for anyone to think the membership is possible before January 1, 2002," Hans Beck, head of the EU's mission in Budapest told a conference on Hungary's media privatisation in Budapest.

"The negotiations will probably start (at the) beginning of 1998," Beck told Reuters. "Let's say you have the negotiations for two years, then you have the ratification process in the member states. In view of our previous experience of expansion it is too optimistic to say even 2001."

The current timetable of negotiations sees talks beginning six months after the completion of the current Inter- Governmental Conference, expected to end mid-1997. The EU Commission has talked of full membership by 2002 at the latest.
